A pilot German picture-naming study for power analysis

Source: R/data.R
naming_pilot.Rd

15 younger and 15 older adults name the same 40 pictures in German. Naming is slower for pictures with less frequent names, more so for older adults. Meant as the pilot data from which to simulate a larger study.

Usage

naming_pilot

Format

A tibble with 1200 rows and 6 columns:

participant

P01 to P30.

age_group

"younger" or "older".

group

age_group contrast-coded: -0.5 younger, 0.5 older.

picture

pic01 to pic40.

freq_c

Centred log10 frequency of the picture name, about -2.5 to 2.5.

latency

Naming latency in ms.

Source

data-raw/naming_pilot.R

Details

True model: log(latency) = 6.75 + 0.15 * group + p0 + w0 + (-0.04 - 0.02 * group + p1) * freq_c + e. By-participant intercepts p0 have SD 0.08 and slopes p1 SD 0.015; by-picture intercepts w0 have SD 0.04; residual SD 0.1.

Examples

head(naming_pilot)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   participant age_group group picture freq_c latency
#>   <fct>       <fct>     <dbl> <fct>    <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1 P01         younger    -0.5 pic01    -0.27     938
#> 2 P01         younger    -0.5 pic02     1.33     777
#> 3 P01         younger    -0.5 pic03     0.9      855
#> 4 P01         younger    -0.5 pic04     2.22     765
#> 5 P01         younger    -0.5 pic05    -2.43     872
#> 6 P01         younger    -0.5 pic06     0.46     779
